metric_definitions.accuracy: correct / all questions in the selected subgroup; invalid, missing and non-ok answers count as incorrect
metric_definitions.response_coverage: valid offered selections with status ok / all questions in the subgroup
metric_definitions.attempt_coverage: recorded predictions / all questions in the subgroup
metric_definitions.invalid: recorded predictions that are not valid, including infrastructure/model errors
metric_definitions.n: number of questions in the declared method scope and selected subgroup
metric_definitions.empty_groups: n = 0 and accuracy = null; empty groups are not scored as zero accuracy
metric_definitions.all_questions: full method cohort, normally 388; includes train and validation diagnostics
metric_definitions.heldout: union of test, test_fault, test_instrument and test_template; normally 114 questions
metric_definitions.uniform_random_accuracy: mean(number of accepted answers / number of offered choices)
metric_definitions.ece: canonical expected calibration error on available selected-answer confidence values
metric_definitions.multiclass_brier: canonical multiclass Brier score where a full probability distribution is available

interpretation: Descriptive snapshot; no significance tests or new uncertainty claims.
Heldout accuracy counts absent/invalid answers as incorrect. ECE uses available selected-answer confidences only; Brier requires full distributions. Confidence and probability coverage are explicit.
T1 reference uses its restricted cohort, not all388 or all114. Old shortlist adapters are separate from actual LangGraph studies.
Attempt coverage includes unsupported/model-error outcomes and does not imply valid responses or success.
L1-L5 are task-construction categories, not a validated increasing difficulty ranking.
L4/L5 select offered plans in static MCQA; they do not measure autonomous sequential execution.
